description: This PHP class, 'requirement_spec_mgr', manages requirement specifications within a broader test management system. It provides functionalities such as creation, retrieval, updating, deletion, and import/export of requirement specs, handling associated custom fields, attachments, and relationships. The class interfaces with database tables, manages hierarchical tree structures for requirements, and supports complex import/export operations via XML. It also includes validation, copying, and coverage analysis features specific to requirement specifications in test projects.

classes.name: requirement_spec_mgr
classes.description: A manager class for handling requirement specifications, providing CRUD operations, validation, import/export, hierarchical management, custom fields handling, and related functionalities within a test management framework.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the requirement_spec_mgr with database connection and sets up related managers.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new requirement specification with provided metadata and inserts it into the system.

methods.name: get_by_id
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a requirement specification by its ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a requirement specification and associated requirements, revisions, and attachments.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing requirement specification, including its metadata and hierarchical node.

methods.name: get_all_in_testproject
methods.description: Fetches all requirement specifications linked to a particular test project.

methods.name: get_requirements
methods.description: Retrieves requirements contained within a requirement specification with options to filter and range.

methods.name: get_by_title
methods.description: Fetches requirement specifications matching a given title within optional scope.

methods.name: check_title
methods.description: Validates if a requirement spec title is non-empty and unique.

methods.name: check_main_data
methods.description: Validates main data fields like title and doc_id for uniqueness and presence.

methods.name: set_order
methods.description: Reorders requirement specifications according to a specified ID-order map.

methods.name: get_requirements_count
methods.description: Counts requirements within a requirement spec based on filters.

methods.name: getReqTree
methods.description: Returns a recursive tree structure of a requirement spec and its children.

methods.name: exportReqSpecToXML
methods.description: Serializes a requirement specification (and optionally its children) into XML format.

methods.name: xmlToReqSpec
methods.description: Parses an XML source into an internal requirement specification representation.

methods.name: xmlToMapReqSpec
methods.description: Converts an XML element into a nested map of requirement spec data.

methods.name: customFieldValuesAsXML
methods.description: Exports custom field values related to a requirement spec into XML format.

methods.name: createFromXML
methods.description: Creates requirement spec and related requirements from an XML input, supporting import operations.

methods.name: get_linked_cfields
methods.description: Retrieves custom fields linked and configured for a specific requirement specification.

methods.name: html_table_of_custom_field_inputs
methods.description: Generates HTML form inputs for custom fields for a requirement spec.

methods.name: html_table_of_custom_field_values
methods.description: Generates HTML table displaying current custom field values for a requirement spec.

methods.name: values_to_db
methods.description: Saves custom field values into the database linked to a requirement spec.

methods.name: copy_to
methods.description: Performs a deep copy of a requirement specification into a new parent/test project.

methods.name: copy_cfields
methods.description: Copies custom field values from a source requirement spec to a target.

methods.name: processAttachments
methods.description: Handles attachments during import/export, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: getByDocID
methods.description: Retrieves requirement spec info by document ID, considering test project and hierarchy.

methods.name: get_by_title
methods.description: Retrieves requirement specs by title with optional parameters for scope and hierarchy.

methods.name: check_title
methods.description: Validates that a requirement spec title is non-empty and not duplicated.

methods.name: check_main_data
methods.description: Validates core data fields for requirement specs such as title and doc_id.
